role: Full-height dashboard layout combining conversation, audio, camera, and drive visualization panels.
detail: ChatView is a React functional component that creates a three-tier layout: (1) top audio strip with mic stream and FFT visualization via AudioPanel, (2) main flex-row with ConversationPanel on left and camera column on right, (3) camera column containing CameraPanel (flex 3) and bottom row splitting RecognitionChips and MiniDriveChart (each flex 1). All sections use MUI Box with consistent styling: rounded borders, translucent backgrounds (rgba(255,255,255,0.03)), and thin stroke borders (rgba(184,217,198,0.12)). Root is full viewport height (100vh) with flexbox column layout, gap 1 (8px), padding 1.5 (12px). No state, hooks, or event handlers — pure presentational orchestration of five child components.
